name: swap two temps
code:
a = [3, 1, 2]
i = 0
j = 1
t = a[i]
a[i] = a[j]
a[j] = t
print(a)

name: bubble sort
selection style swap
code:
a = [9, 4, 6]
m = 0
for i in range(1, 3):
    if a[i] < a[m]:
        m = i
t = a[0]
a[0] = a[m]
a[m] = t
print(a)

name: in loop accumulate
swap variables via tuple
code:
a = 1
b = 2
a, b = b, a
print(a, b)

name: reverse via temp
code:
a = [1, 2, 3, 4]
n = len(a)
for i in range(n // 2):
    t = a[i]
    a[i] = a[n - 1 - i]
    a[n - 1 - i] = t
print(a)
